comments.author: @Fee_Bass
comments.text: I filled an eating addiction with a shopping addiction (and now I flop between the two in chunks of time). I was very fortunate in that I was allowed to take early retirement at 34. I had gotten addicted to eating because of the extreme stress, anxiety, and depression my job(s) were putting on me. I gained over 120lbs in just a couple years. When I got set free, my goal was to get the real me back not just for me, but for my loving husband ( who never said a thing against me or my weight, just loved me no matter what). I lost tons of weight ( I tortured myself, honestly) very fast ( 60lbs in 1 month and now a few years later, down just over 100) so, I had to buy new clothes. That's how the replacement addiction started. So now, if I'm not eating I'm shopping and if I'm not shopping I'm eating. My husband gives me an allowance for the year of money I can spend how ever I want (it's usually our tax return). I like having that budget that I can manage instead of just getting free reign and doing whatever on which ever whim. He recently, for years going forward, wants to give me 30K a year. I said absolutely not. Invest it, please. If you give me that much,  I'll spend that much. I do not want it. I'll take my usual amount ( like, 7k) and that's more than enough. I can spend it, or save it over the years if I choose.
